en.text:
<solar/>Solar Ability and <solar/>Ignition Kills grant one stack of 'Roaring Flames' for 20 seconds. Maximum of 3 stacks.

Roaring Flames grants increased <solar/>Solar Ability damage at 1|2|3 stacks:
• <pve 20% /> <pvp [13%] /> | <pve 44% /> <pvp [28%] /> | <pve 73% /> <pvp [44%] /> Increased Grenade and Super Damage
• 67%|133%|200% Increased Base Melee Damage

While Roaring Flames is active, Unpowered Melee Hits apply <solar/>30 Scorch (40 with <solar/>Ember of Ashes) and count as Powered Melee Hits.
